parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation to obtain the ID.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number for the paged query. Settings this parameter for paging. Default value: 1. Valid values: 1 to 100000.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for the paged query. This parameter is used for paging. Valid values: 1 to 500.

parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description:
The field by which to sort the results. By default, the results are sorted by purchase time. Valid values:

- **CreateTime**: purchase time.
- **ExpireTime**: expiration time.

parameters.name: SortOrder
parameters.description:
The sort order. Default value: desc. Valid values:

- **asc**: ascending order.
- **desc**: descending order.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The instance status. Valid values:
- **online**: The instance is running normally.
- **offline**: The instance has expired but has not exceeded the retention period and is unavailable.
- **disable**: The instance has been released.
- **overdue**: The instance has an overdue payment.
